title: Door Clear Width
description: Generic doorway minimum clear opening width for everyday review models.
interpretation_notes: Clear width measured as minimum unobstructed opening. AABB width used as proxy; actual clear width may differ with door frame offsets.

title: Stair Headroom
description: Minimum vertical clearance above stair travel path.
interpretation_notes: Headroom measured from nosing line to soffit. AABB height used as approximation; actual headroom may vary along stair run.

title: Window Opening Height
description: Basic window opening height proxy using window geometry for quick demo reviews.
interpretation_notes: Demo rule only. Not tied to a specific code clause. Uses AABB height as window opening height proxy.

title: Railing Height
description: Generic fall-protection railing minimum height review rule.
interpretation_notes: NBC specifies 1.0m minimum railing height from finished floor. AABB height used as proxy; actual measurement should be from adjacent floor to top of railing.

title: Ramp Gradient
description: Accessible ramp slope should not exceed 1:12 where ramp data is available.
interpretation_notes: 1:12 slope (8.33%) is the NBC maximum for accessible ramps. Slope property expected as ratio (rise/run). Landings at top/bottom not checked by this rule.
